about: The Swedish krona's settlement calendar (Stockholm): the days Swedish banks are closed, 1990-2100. The public holidays (New Year's Day, Epiphany, Good Friday, Easter Monday, May 1, Ascension Day, National Day, Christmas Day, Boxing Day) and the eves banks also close for: Midsummer Eve (the Friday between June 19 and 25), Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve. National Day (June 6) replaced Whit Monday as a public holiday from 2005. A holiday on a weekend isn't moved, and two on one day are one day (Ascension on May 1, 2008). Checked against SEB's 2024 and 2026 Nordic bank holiday lists; other years are the rules unchecked against a published list, including whether banks closed on the eves before 2024.
